firstPlayerRule: Whoever most recently prepared a drink goes first. Turns proceed clockwise.
houseFallback: If this criterion does not suit your group, agree to choose randomly. This is a house rule.
clarifications: That player keeps the First Player token for the whole game.
When choosing starting potions, draft the first potion clockwise from the starter, then the second potion in reverse order from the last player.
